entities.summary: Vladimir Yulyevich Wiese was a Russian scientist of German descent who devoted his life to the study of the Arctic ice pack. His name is associated with the Scientific Prediction of Ice Conditions theory. Wiese was a member of the Soviet Arctic Institute and an authority on polar oceanography. He was also the founder of the Geographico-hydrological School of Oceanography. Vladimir Wiese was a explorers & navigators from Pushkin (1886-03-05, Pushkin–1954-02-19). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to environmental history.
